create_basescheduler: create a BaseScheduler instance with a config dict and torch optimizer for learning rate scheduling
step_basescheduler: step the BaseScheduler forward by one iteration to update learning rates for each param group
step_epoch_basescheduler: step the BaseScheduler forward by one epoch to update learning rates for each param group
state_dict_basescheduler: get the serializable state dict from a BaseScheduler instance excluding the optimizer and config
load_state_dict_basescheduler: load a previously saved state dict into a BaseScheduler and restore the last epoch and iteration
